converging.name: You're not the only one (weekly sweep)
converging.publisher: Our own sweep of OpenAlex (CC0), arXiv, GitHub and Hacker News
converging.caveats: Pairs are found by word overlap; dates are publication dates, not when work began.

participedia.name: Participedia
participedia.publisher: Research network led from the University of British Columbia; cases written by contributors
participedia.updates: Continuous; we re-read changed cases daily
participedia.caveats: Quality varies by author; about 4 in 10 cases have no written-up outcome. Not usable commercially.

worldbank.name: World Bank · IEG project ratings
worldbank.publisher: Independent Evaluation Group, World Bank Group (intergovernmental)
worldbank.caveats: Rates achievement of the project's own objectives, not wider impact. Placed at country level only.

github.name: GitHub archived repositories
github.licence: Metadata, linked; each repository has its own licence
github.caveats: Stars measure attention, not quality. Locations are what owners typed on their profile.

trials.name: ClinicalTrials.gov stopped studies
trials.publisher: US National Library of Medicine (government registry)
trials.caveats: The stop reason is free text from the sponsor; our grouping of reasons is automatic. Drawn at the first listed site.

stuck.name: Everything we're stuck on (daily sky)
stuck.publisher: Our own collection: Wikipedia unsolved-problem lists (CC BY-SA), Erdős problems, Open Problem Garden, Gap Map, OpenAlex
stuck.caveats: Curated lists are strong; problems pulled from paper abstracts by OpenAlex text are automated and weaker, so they are drawn fainter.

osm.name: OpenStreetMap
osm.caveats: A mapped place may have closed. Coverage is much denser in Europe than elsewhere.

givefood.name: Give Food
givefood.type: Charity, read from food banks' own websites
givefood.caveats: Lists are a hint, not a prescription; lists older than 120 days are not drawn. UK only.
